why_trail.why: Handoff complete on all 8 fields. Composition pieces verified: run_stage_h reads composition via ReferenceUtilizationStore.get(...).fingerprint = __field__ field-median row (NOT constructor); join_weekend_prior gives T7-1 uniform->unweighted-mean; fit.py filters round_idx<=as_of_round so as_of_round=R-1 excludes R; derive_pilot_vocabulary(field class_ids,2023)->k=4 UNVERIFIED (fit allow_unverified). Slice: rounds 3-22 covered, 20 drivers, channels utilization=time_deficit_s / energy=deployment_share.

load_field_composition returns product.fingerprint (rebuilt from __field__ row alone by the store); uniform_composition gives equal 1/k weights for the T7-1 baseline. Composition-source guard test green.

fit_cells_as_of derives as_of=held_out_round-1 (caller passes R, cannot pass a leaking cutoff); run_stage_g uses fit_driver_fingerprints round_idx<=as_of. arm_fingerprint = join(field_comp, cells). Leakage-guard test green + counterfactual proves it bites.
arm_baseline = join_weekend_prior(uniform_composition, same cells). T7-1 identity green: uniform comp -> prior.mean == unweighted resolved-cell mean; Student-t preserved.

golf_null_field_pool filters round_idx<held_out_round (SQL) + raises if max(rounds_used)>=R; NO driver grouping. compose_golf_null_prior = join-identical weight arithmetic + independent-class quadrature + predictive_t (heavy tail via nu_loss, no baked normality). Both guard+floor tests green.

Scoring (student-t logpdf/|resid|/coverage) + run_diagnostic + md/json report done; whole test file (5 guards/identity) green. Real run: unresolvable=[3], thin=[4,5], resolved=[6..22]. FINDING: arms1/2 predictive sigma dominated by landed-#666 fit's g_sigma_onesided grip term (p90~8e9 vs deficit~0.1s) -> vacuously wide intervals, log-score not equal-footing vs golf null; report leads with sigma-robust |resid|: arm1 0.854 < arm2 1.14 (composition-weighting helps point), golf 0.830 ~= arm1 (driver term doesn't beat field null on this bounded slice).
Real diagnostic run produces both report artifacts (md+json); full fingerprint suite 108 passed/13 skipped; pyright-0 on both new files. All close criteria met.
